title: Heating steam taken from the compressor discharge (model review)
reason: As built, V-201 was heated by a separate fixed 251.7 t/h steam feed while the K-201 discharge went to a second copy of the heater (E-201), so the compressor did not limit the boil-up. Corrected: V-201 heating = K-201 discharge + turbine exhaust (E-201 is V-201's heater, not a second one); desuperheating as spray mixing, not heat removed (the superheat stays in the steam); excess vapour to E-301 as 8.4 % of boil-up (20.9 of 247.7 t/h, Table I) so it scales.

V-301.error: inlet is vapour in the water stand-in: brine above the water saturation temperature at its pressure only stays liquid through its BPE; give that feed at a pressure where water is liquid

title: Purge evaporator: liquid feed, boil-off set by its heating steam (model review)
reason: The purge liquor (line 5001) was given at 125.6 C and 1.70 bar(a): in the water stand-in that is steam (the brine is liquid only through its BPE), which gave a negative V-301 duty. It now leaves at the circulation-pump pressure (2.73 bar(a)) and flashes through FV-301. V-301 boil-off set to 44 % of its feed (~21 t/h): the 25.4 t/h overheads in Table I include the desuperheating water, and the 20.9 t/h of heating vapour cannot boil more. E-301 area 1,500 m2 (illustrative rating, data sheet updated; the patent gives none).

title: Close the V-201 forced-circulation loop and account for desuperheating spray
reason: Line 2001 was an external 17,850 t/h feed even though the P&ID shows it leaving V-201. The correction closes V-201 liquid -> splitter -> P-201 -> recycle -> V-201, uses the fresh brine and net slurry streams for the salt/heat balance, and adds the 9.019 t/h desuperheating-water mass implied by the patent Table I difference between compressor+turbine steam and the 251.7 t/h heater flow. No equipment rating was changed.

title: Use the documented stand-in closure tolerance for the salt heat balances
reason: The water/brine stand-in omits crystallisation heat and electrolyte phase equilibrium. The model review already treats energy gaps below 10% as warnings; use the same explicit 10% model-closure tolerance in capacity checks. This changes no physical equipment rating.

title: Scale the V-201 recycle tear guess during capacity search
reason: The recycle is an internal stream and its initial solver guess must scale with plant throughput. Keeping the 17,850 t/h guess fixed caused false non-convergence above the base rate; no physical rating or process topology changes.
